Linked to time of day.en: My heart feels like it is trembling or quivering in the evening while I am sitting.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बैठे हुए दिल काँपता हुआ महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko baithe hue dil kapta hua mehsus hota hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Heart & Circulation, trembling, heart, night
Linked to time of day.en: My heart feels like it is trembling or quivering at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय दिल काँपता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke samay dil kapta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Heart & Circulation, trembling, heart, night, in bed
Linked to time of day.en: My heart feels like it is trembling or quivering at night while I am in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बिस्तर पर दिल काँपने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bistar par dil kapne lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Heart & Circulation, trembling, heart, waking, on
Linked to time of day.en: My heart feels like it is trembling or quivering when I first wake up.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद से जागने पर दिल काँपने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind se jagne par dil kapne lagta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Heart & Circulation, trembling, heart, lying agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: My heart trembling or quivering feeling gets worse when I lie down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर दिल की कँपकँपी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par dil ki kampkampi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Heart & Circulation, trembling, heart, lying on left side agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: My heart trembling or quivering feeling gets worse when I lie on my left side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बाईं करवट लेटने पर दिल काँपने लगता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bayin karvat letne par dil kapne lagta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Heart & Circulation, trembling, heart, sitting, while
Linked to posture/position.en: My heart feels like it is trembling or quivering while I am sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे रहने पर दिल काँपता हुआ महसूस होता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithe rehne par dil kapta hua mehsus hota hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Heart & Circulation, trembling, heart, menses, after
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: My heart feels like it is trembling or quivering after my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी खत्म होने के बाद दिल काँपने लगता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari khatm hone ke baad dil kapne lagta hai.

General sensation.en: My heart trembling or quivering comes and goes in sudden attacks or episodes.
General sensation.hi: दिल की कँपकँपी अचानक दौरे की तरह आती है।
General sensation.roman: Dil ki kampkampi achanak daure ki tarah ati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Heart & Circulation, weakness, heart
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My heart feels weak.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दिल कमज़ोर हो गया हो, ऐसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dil kamzor ho gaya ho, aisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Heart & Circulation, weakness, heart, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: I have a sensation of weakness or faintness in my heart.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दिल में कमज़ोरी का अहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dil mein kamzori ka ahsaas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Heart & Circulation, weakness, heart, sensation of, about the
Sensation / feel of the area.en: I have a vague sensation of weakness spread around the area of my heart.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दिल के आसपास कमज़ोरी जैसा अहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dil ke aaspass kamzori jaisa ahsaas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Heart & Circulation, weakness, heart, sensation of, tired feeling
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My heart has a tired, weak feeling, as if it is exhausted.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दिल में थकान जैसी कमज़ोरी का अहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dil mein thakan jaisi kamzori ka ahsaas hota hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Heart & Circulation, weakness, heart, sensation of, after entering cool room from a walk in hot sun
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: I get a sensation of weakness or faintness in my heart after coming inside to a cool room from walking in hot sunshine.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: धूप में चलकर ठंडे कमरे में घुसने पर दिल में कमज़ोरी का अहसास होता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Dhup mein chalkar thande kamare mein ghusne par dil mein kamzori ka ahsaas hota hai.
